newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won hits all time low of 827.00 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won hits all time low of 827.00 - dealers.

text.p: The South Korean won hit an all-time low of 827.00 against the U.S. dollar in early afternoon trading on Monday, dealers said.
The won's previous historic low was 826.10 on August 16.

Dealers said the won fell sharply on aggressive dollar buying after it become clear that the central Bank of Korea was not going to intervene to prop up the local currency during the early afternoon session.
The bank stepped into the interbank market twice at 823.40 and 826.60 in the morning to cap the dollar's rise against the won.
Dealers said the dollar would surge until the central bank intervened again. The bank never comments on intervention.
